name: pickup_find_droppable_type_for_player_current_weapon
description: Pickup::FindDroppableTypeForPlayerCurrentWeapon maps the active alt weapon key to the matching droppable pickup type in the weapon pickup range and falls back to pickup type 0 on miss.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a pickup/GameNet source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja has a known sbb flag-generation limitation in the inlined strcmp mismatch path at 0x41e9c3; the implementation uses source-level strcmp for the same key comparison.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41e980 validates saveState in ECX, activeAltGunController at playerState+0x5e4, optCatalogEntry->keyName at controller+0, scanning g_PickupTypes entries 17 through 33 inclusive by weaponKeyName, returning the matching table entry, and returning g_PickupTypes[0] on miss.
The native smoke covers an interior match, the last scanned pickup type, and the fallback to g_PickupTypes[0] when no weapon key matches.
